mapper.sql: select f.id, f.code, f.entry_date, f.fabric_year, f.category_id, f.supplier_id, f.product_name, f.weight, f.width, f.color_no, f.composition_code, f.composition_summary, f.price_value, f.price_unit, f.meter_price, f.notes, f.del_flag, f.create_by, f.create_time, f.update_by, f.update_time, s.name as supplier_name, concat(pc.name, ' / ', c.name) as category_name, case when u.nick_name is not null and trim(u.nick_name) != '' and u.nick_name != f.create_by then concat(u.nick_name, '（', f.create_by, '）') else f.create_by end as recorder_name, coalesce(inv.stock_count, 0) as inventory_stock_count from fabric f left join fabric_supplier s on s.id = f.supplier_id left join fabric_category c on c.id = f.category_id left join fabric_category pc on pc.id = c.parent_id left join sys_user u on u.user_name = f.create_by and u.del_flag = '0' left join ( select fabric_id, count(*) as stock_count from inventory_stock where del_flag='0' and fabric_id is not null group by fabric_id ) inv on inv.fabric_id=f.id
mapper.select:
f.del_flag = '0'
and lower(f.code) like lower(concat('%', #{code}, '%'))
and lower(f.product_name) like lower(concat('%', #{productName}, '%'))
and f.supplier_id = #{supplierId}
and f.fabric_year = #{year}

select f.id, f.code, f.fabric_year, f.entry_date from fabric f where f.fabric_year = #{year} and f.del_flag = '0' and not exists ( select 1 from fabric_image fi where fi.fabric_id = f.id ) order by f.id
select count(*) from fabric where fabric_year = #{year} and del_flag = '0'
select count(*) from fabric where fabric_year = #{year}
select count(*) from fabric where del_flag = '0'
select count(*) from fabric_supplier
select count(*) from fabric_image fi join fabric f on f.id = fi.fabric_id where f.del_flag = '0'
select count(distinct fi.fabric_id) from fabric_image fi join fabric f on f.id = fi.fabric_id where f.del_flag = '0'
select cast(fabric_year as varchar) as name, count(*) as `value` from fabric where del_flag = '0' group by fabric_year order by fabric_year

select coalesce(pc.name, c.name) as name, count(*) as `value` from fabric f left join fabric_category c on c.id = f.category_id left join fabric_category pc on pc.id = c.parent_id where f.del_flag = '0' group by coalesce(pc.name, c.name) order by count(*) desc, coalesce(pc.name, c.name)
select price_unit as name, count(*) as `value` from fabric where del_flag = '0' group by price_unit order by count(*) desc, price_unit
where f.del_flag = '0' order by f.entry_date desc, f.create_time desc, f.id desc limit 6
mapper.insert: insert into fabric ( code, entry_date, fabric_year, category_id, supplier_id, product_name, weight, width, color_no, composition_code, composition_summary, price_value, price_unit, meter_price, notes, del_flag, create_by, create_time ) values ( #{code}, #{entryDate}, #{year}, #{categoryId}, #{supplierId}, #{productName}, #{weight}, #{width}, #{colorNo}, #{compositionCode}, #{compositionSummary}, #{priceValue}, #{priceUnit}, #{meterPrice}, #{notes}, '0', #{createBy}, current_timestamp )
mapper.update: update fabric set code = #{code}, entry_date = #{entryDate}, fabric_year = #{year}, category_id = #{categoryId}, supplier_id = #{supplierId}, product_name = #{productName}, weight = #{weight}, width = #{width}, color_no = #{colorNo}, composition_code = #{compositionCode}, composition_summary = #{compositionSummary}, price_value = #{priceValue}, price_unit = #{priceUnit}, meter_price = #{meterPrice}, notes = #{notes}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = current_timestamp where id = #{id} and del_flag = '0'

#{id}
mapper.select: select id, name, phone, address, remarks, create_time from fabric_supplier order by name
select id, name, phone, address, remarks, create_time from fabric_supplier where lower(name) = lower(#{name}) limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into fabric_supplier (name, phone, address, remarks, create_time) values (#{name}, #{phone}, #{address}, #{remarks}, current_timestamp)
mapper.select: select id, parent_id, name, category_level, sort_order from fabric_category order by category_level, parent_id, sort_order, id
select count(*) from fabric_category where parent_id = #{parentId}
select code, name_cn, name_en, sort_order from fabric_component_type where enabled = '1' order by sort_order, code
mapper.insert: insert into fabric_code_sequence (fabric_year, last_value) select #{year}, 0 where not exists ( select 1 from fabric_code_sequence where fabric_year = #{year} )
mapper.select: select last_value from fabric_code_sequence where fabric_year = #{year} for update

select fc.id, fc.fabric_id, fc.component_code, fct.name_cn as component_name_cn, fct.name_en as component_name_en, fc.percentage, fc.sort_order from fabric_composition fc left join fabric_component_type fct on fct.code = fc.component_code where fc.fabric_id = #{fabricId} order by fc.sort_order, fc.id
select id, fabric_id, image_url, thumbnail_url, image_type, sort_order, create_time from fabric_image where fabric_id = #{fabricId} order by sort_order, id
